1373476127327408132 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 11
"would there still be taxes in eutopia?"

I've been pondering this question sometimes, in light of the famous quote: "’Tis impossible to be sure of any thing but Death and Taxes"

My hunch is "yes in some sense but they'd look very different."

https://t.co/TegMF3TzOi
  [Quoting @Malcolm_Ocean: Eutopia is, by definition, the answer to the question "where are we when we ask if we're there yet and everyone says yes"]
↓
1373476128640278531 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 8 🔁 1
That quote about death & taxes seems to express a deeper systems truth:

• all things must end
• all things, while they maintain, must maintain an environment

And these would continue to be true in eutopia.
↓
1373476129906958337 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 4
Parts must maintain the order within the wholes they are part of, for the parts to continue to survive & thrive.

Taxes are a super crude way to do that, especially when the systems that are in charge of figuring out how to use the resources are bad at sensemaking & dialogue.
↓
1373476131106549762 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 4
But insofar as for various reasons whole-managers are needed (which, beyond coordination problems, are often for interfacing with that-which-is-outside-a-given-whole—this is why we have a self, and why burning man needs an org) they need support of various kinds.
↓
1373476132100567040 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 5
Interestingly, companies work kind of the opposite of this: the employees need to do work to support the whole (which is the taxes) but then money flows from the whole to the parts.

Likewise with eating food & breathing air, and it getting distributed to every organ & cell.
↓
1373476133044326403 [2021-03-21] @Malcolm_Ocean 💜 4
Then we get into ~game theory~ because ofc there's such a thing as a person who drives on roads but pays no taxes, or an employee who collects a salary but does no work (or sabotages).

freeloading is a thing. but it's only a good deal in meh circumstances
https://t.co/t6JfIDsWIZ
  [Quoting @Malcolm_Ocean: @Evolving_Ego Most ppl, on an emotional level, want to do meaningful work more than they want to eat & be housed while feeling like a burden on society.  So UBI becomes a way to free peoples' energy from boring jobs, fear, etc, giving space for exploration & creativity. https://t.co/b63sTqBuJl]
